en.title: Nobel prize winners
en.summary: Scientists from the English-speaking world who won the Nobel Prize, and how to write about awards.

paragraphs: The Nobel Prizes are the best-known awards in science. In this lesson you will read about some winners from Britain, Ireland and the United States and practise the passive voice with by, for and in.

The prizes were established by the will of Alfred Nobel, a Swedish chemist who invented dynamite, and they have been awarded every year since 1901 for physics, chemistry, medicine, literature and peace. Marie Curie, who was born in Poland and worked in France, was awarded the Physics Prize in 1903 and the Chemistry Prize in 1911. In 1945 the Medicine Prize was shared by Alexander Fleming, Howard Florey and Ernst Chain for the discovery and development of penicillin. In 1962 James Watson, Francis Crick and Maurice Wilkins received the same prize for describing the structure of DNA. Dorothy Hodgkin, an English chemist, won the Chemistry Prize in 1964 for her work on the structure of important molecules.

paragraphs: **1. The passive often uses by for the agent and for for the reason.** Awarded for the discovery of penicillin; the prize was shared by three scientists. See Introduction to Grammar: Voice.

blocks.html:
ActivePassive
The committee awarded the prize to Hodgkin.The prize was awarded to Hodgkin.
Three scientists shared it.It was shared by three scientists.

paragraphs: **2. The present perfect passive describes things that continue.** Use has been or have been + participle. See Introduction to Grammar: Past tenses.

blocks.html:
FormExample
have been awardedThe prizes have been awarded since 1901.
has been wonIt has been won by many women.

items: **Laureate** is a person who has won a prize.
**Awarded to** introduces the person; **awarded for** gives the reason.
**Share** a prize means to receive it together with others.

paragraphs: The prizes are presented in Stockholm on 10 December, the anniversary of Nobel's death in 1896. The Peace Prize is given in Oslo.
